item.description:
just had a full mental breakdown in a Wendy’s parking lot and I think I accidentally uncovered the fast food pantheon

hot dog barked
nugget bit me
pizza sliced through reality
fries started riverdancing in the bag

then the wind whispered:
"what does the burger say?"

nom nom nom nom nommy nom
chew chew chew chew chompy chomp
munch munch munch munch tasty crunch

soda started slurping itself
burrito did a backflip into the void
I saw Ronald McDonald and he looked tired

“the fast food knows all,” he said, “but none remember.”

and then I woke up with bbq sauce on my shirt and $23 of DoorDash debt
